If you're looking for carpet cleaning in Glen Waverley, here are some well-reviewed local options:

- Jim's Carpet Cleaning Glen Waverley – 5.0★ (59 reviews). Offers carpet steam cleaning, stain removal, and upholstery cleaning.
- Classy Property Cleaning – 5.0★ (42 reviews). Provides residential and commercial carpet cleaning.
- Edge Cleaning Facility Services – 4.8★ (22 reviews). Open 24/7 and offers carpet cleaning for homes and businesses.
- Ivy Property Services – 4.7★ (55 reviews). Offers carpet cleaning alongside general cleaning services.
- Dan's Building Solutions – 4.8★ (57 reviews). Provides carpet cleaning and restoration services.

Typical carpet cleaning services include:
- Steam (hot water extraction) cleaning
- Dry carpet cleaning
- Stain and spot removal
- Pet odour treatment
- Upholstery and rug cleaning

Pricing in the area commonly starts from around **$35–$40 per room**, with the final cost depending on room size, carpet condition, and any stain treatments required. [www.carpetcleaningglenwaverley.com](https://www.carpetcleaningglenwaverley.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you're after the best value, it's worth requesting quotes from 2–3 companies and asking:
- Is deodorising included?
- Are there extra charges for stain treatment?
- How long will the carpets take to dry?
- Do you offer an end-of-lease guarantee (if applicable)?
